messages:
marta: Quick check — demo scheduled Thu 22:00 APAC. Need ~12 H100s in asia-east1 for ~4h. Vendor said maybe available but need ETA. Anyone have current spare pool / quota?
ashwin: tagging @jin — can infra spare ~12 for that window?
jin: We currently have 6 free in edge-pool-apac (zone a). Not 12. I'll ping vendor + open a ticket.
procure-bot: Ticket INC-4521 created: 'APAC H100 demo borrow request' — procurement team looping vendor.
liam: If vendor can't do 12, we could mix with preemptible A100s in us-west2 for some users — latency might be OK for recordings. :thinking_face:
marta: Prefer local APAC for the audience, but A100 fallback is acceptable for 4 nodes. @jin can runtime do automatic fallback? any perf caveats?
jin: Runtime can auto-fallback; need a small policy + quant profile tweak. Perf note: A100 will slightly increase latency for long configs, and we should adjust batch_size. I'll prepare a quick config snippet now.
jin: ```
model_policy:
  prefer: h100
  fallback: a100-8g
  batch_size: 8
  quant_profile: dynamic7
```
marta: Nice. Also need GCP quota bump for project "redwood-demo" region asia-east1: +12 NVIDIA_H100. Ashwin — can you file the quota request?
ashwin: Filed quota request CRQ-7892 just now. GCP console link: https://console.cloud.google.com/compute/quotas?project=redwood-demo (open in your browser).
procure-bot: Vendor SkylineAI replied: "We can commit 8 H100s in asia-east1-a for Thu 22:00-02:00 local time. Remaining 4 require 48h lead time."
jin: OK plan then: use 8 H100s + 4 A100 fallback. I'll ensure runtime policy above is active for that route. We should also validate quantization profile on A100.
liam: I'll update the demo playbook (steps + fallback) and add a canary route to us-west2 in case regional swap is needed. Will open PR in ~30m.
marta: :thumbsup: I'll block the calendar for that slot. Please post final vendor confirmation here so I can send invites.
ashwin: Adding vendor reply to CRQ-7892 and to INC-4521. Calendar hold created.
procure-bot: Ticket INC-4521 updated: vendor availability confirmed for 8 H100s; 4 deferred. Next step: confirm A100 test coverage and runtime smoke tests. cc: @jin
jin: I'll run a quick smoke with the a100-8g profile today and post results here.
liam: PR opened with playbook updates and fallback steps: https://git.internal/redwood/demo-playbook/pull/402 (WIP).
marta: Thanks all — very helpful. Please paste the final allocation here when vendor confirms full 12 or if anything changes.
ashwin: Will do.
marta: Thanks!
liam: LGTM on the plan.
procure-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up with vendor in 12h if no confirmation.
